At FunPlay, a playground is part of the site plan, not an afterthought.

We design every unit for developers, schools and public bodies with one aim: a space that families actually use and remember. We know what a project team is up against, from tight handover dates to fixed budgets and buyer expectations.

So our layouts are drawn to fit your plan early, our team handles the installation, and the units are built to stay safe and good-looking for years. A well-used play area helps the project's reputation long after handover.
